name: OpenGEO
description: OpenGEO measures whether changing a piece of content changes whether an AI answer engine cites it. Documents are supplied to the model in context, so retrieval is held constant and the synthesis stage is measured in isolation. Every round uses a paired design in which only the document under test differs between arms, is pre-registered before collection, and ships its corpus, harness and raw model responses so the result can be re-run and checked.
